implemented_capabilities.capability: Transitive dependency blast-radius traversal from CVE to apps, assets, teams
implemented_capabilities.notes: Cypher variable-length (DEPENDS_ON*0..N, default 4) from (Vulnerability)-[:AFFECTS]->(Package) up through (Application)-[:USES]->(Package), then DEPLOYED_AS Asset and OWNED_BY Team; evidence paths limited to 20. Plain FalkorDB Cypher, no GDS.

Pure-Python additive score (severity 40 + asset criticality 30 + log-scaled reach 20 + exposure 10 - 15 incomplete-evidence penalty), labels CRITICAL/HIGH/MEDIUM/LOW/UNCERTAIN, and lists missing evidence rather than assuming low risk. Note README says 'reachability' but code only counts affected applications (no call-graph reachability); EPSS/exploit fields in the README table are not used by the scorer.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Investigation workflow ('agent') with optional LLM summary
implemented_capabilities.notes: A fixed 11-step procedural pipeline calling graph queries then the scorer; it is not an LLM-planned agent. LLM (OpenAI/Anthropic) only rewrites a 3-5 sentence summary and degrades to deterministic mode if no key.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Remediation records linked to investigation and finding
implemented_capabilities.notes: POST /remediations creates (Remediation)-[:ADDRESSES]->(Finding) and -[:SUPPORTED_BY]->(Investigation) with status hard-set to 'approved' at creation; the POST itself is the 'approval'. Action is simulated (docstring: 'simulated remediation action'). Investigation results are stored as a frozen JSON snapshot string.

implemented_capabilities.capability: Interactive dependency graph / evidence path UI
implemented_capabilities.notes: React pages for overview, graph, investigate, remediations and status.

graph_models_and_cypher: Single graph (FALKORDB_GRAPH). Nodes: Vulnerability{cvss_score,cve,incomplete_evidence}, Package{name,version,ecosystem}, Application, Asset{criticality,exposed,environment}, Team, Finding{status,source,detected_at,incomplete_evidence}, Investigation{result JSON}, Remediation{status}. Edges: AFFECTS, DEPENDS_ON, USES, DEPLOYED_AS (README says DEPLOYS_TO), OWNED_BY, IDENTIFIES (Finding->Vulnerability), INVESTIGATES, ADDRESSES, SUPPORTED_BY, PROPOSED_FOR. Variable-length paths with depth f-string interpolated from a Python int default (max_depth=4); all ids parameterized. Uses pattern predicates in WHERE ((entry)-[:DEPENDS_ON*0..N]->(vp)) which FalkorDB supports. No APOC/GDS.
algorithms: Reverse transitive-dependency closure bounded by max_depth (queries.py:544-577)
Application-to-vulnerable-package path enumeration ordered by hops, LIMIT 20 (queries.py:696-727)
Log-scaled reach score min(20, 20*ln(n+1)/ln(11)) and additive priority formula (prioritization.py)
frontend_interfaces: React 19 + TS: OverviewPage, GraphPage, InvestigatePage (589 lines), RemediationsPage, StatusPage; components DependencyGraph, EvidencePathView, PriorityScoreCard, RemediationModal
agent_or_memory_mechanisms: None beyond persisting Investigation and Remediation nodes; no memory recall, no handoff. 'Autonomous agent' is a scripted function pipeline.
tests_present: backend/tests/test_patchpilot.py: 45 test functions - 13 pure unit tests of the scoring engine (no DB) and ~32 integration tests (seed idempotency, traversal, ownership, investigation/remediation persistence, API) that skip if FalkorDB is unavailable. Not executed by auditor.
security_findings: backend/app/api/routes.py:221-231 - POST /seed?clear_first=true is unauthenticated and runs MATCH (n) DETACH DELETE n (queries.py:~302) wiping the whole graph.

backend/app/graph/queries.py:544-727 - max_depth interpolated into Cypher via f-string; currently always the default 4 (routes/agent do not pass user input) but the function signature would be injectable if exposed.

backend/app/agent/investigator.py:78-130 - sends vulnerability text and asset names to OpenAI/Anthropic when LLM_PROVIDER is set; keys read from settings/env only; .env.example contains placeholders only.
backend/app/api/routes.py:171-193 - remediation endpoint auto-sets status 'approved' with no authn/authz or reviewer identity; any caller can 'approve' actions.
backend/app/api/routes.py:~186 - detail=str(exc) returned in HTTP 500 bodies can leak internals; unused get_all_vulnerabilities() call is executed on every remediation POST.
CORS limited to localhost origins by default (config.py:26) - good.
duplicates_or_overlaps: Overlaps software dependency blast radius / vulnerability reachability with many sibling repos (e.g. other CVE-to-asset-to-team traversal projects). Little unique beyond the compact scoring engine with UNCERTAIN label for incomplete evidence.
evidence_drift_relevance: LOW - It flags incomplete evidence (UNCERTAIN label, missing_evidence list) and links remediations to investigations/findings, but investigations are frozen JSON snapshots with no re-evaluation, versioning, supersession or invalidation when the graph changes, and 'approval' is auto-assigned.

strongest_reusable_unit.why: Small pure-Python, unit-tested, transparent scoring function that returns per-factor contributions and an explicit missing-evidence list with an UNCERTAIN label instead of defaulting to low risk; easy to adapt as an evidence-completeness-aware priority scorer.

strategy_rationale: The CVE-to-package-to-app-to-asset-to-team traversal and scorer fit a Security & Vulnerability capability pack; Kairos can lift prioritization.py and re-express the five Cypher queries on its own schema. Not worth merging wholesale because the agent is a fixed pipeline and the remediation 'approval' is simulated.
